set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-1.0; milestone-mapping.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: At 8d4881a no MappingPipeline implementation or suite was found. Reuse existing M1 codecs, exchange CLI, timing/text-source components and ADR 0022; new consumers never import embed-bench.

Remaining / next action: Implement the public MappingPipeline/CLI using checked inputs and explicit profiles, one outcome per unit/participant, truthful requested-capability status and atomic/manifest-last resume-safe publication. The existing fixture exporter is not this facade.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Current prerequisites: reconstruction bd-01M2TAD04SR823TQVG9VPNH6R3, reference bd-01M2WVF86T8QEEA1TK8Z0ASJHW, timing bd-01M2WVH1DC8ZPDC992G4MX3TXG (compatibility removed by owner decision 2026-09-22).

AC6 (owner decision 2026-09-22): every run publishes BOTH the local reference mapping and the named structured reconstruction, each with stage provenance, and the lambda weight when bd-01M35MHPFFKQHSJKC07VMWC7CW lands; the facade offers no organization/order readouts until compatibility (1.1) lands -- such a request returns an explicit missing-capability outcome.

Scheduling lane: next. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Governing plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md (2026-09-19); ADR 0019. Key: command; lane: next.

Scope: pipeline mapping facade, codec publication manifest

Acceptance criteria:
1. Public typed API and thin CLI accept checked source/recall inputs and explicit versioned profiles; no bench imports. Resolve config once; reject invalid config rather than environment fallback.
2. Produce one outcome per input unit and participant, including failure, abstention and external alternatives; batch failures remain local. Exit policy separates execution, structural validity and requested capability readiness, preserving receipted partial outputs.
3. Write to verified temporary output then atomic rename, or completion manifest last with readers refusing incomplete output. Do not overwrite historical runs silently; interruption and corrupt-output tests fail closed.
4. Cache identities bind source/provider/render/config; enforce offline replay/no network and budgeted retries. Frozen legacy structured preset matches baseline scientific outputs; reference uses its own explicit policy.
5. Reference provenance is derived from registered supported stages. Unverifiable custom/legacy results remain UnknownProvenance/ModelDependentOnly; do not wait for a universal custom-cost authentication protocol to ship honest exploratory output.

Validation: proposed MappingPipelineSuite and public CLI replay/crash tests

Completion evidence: exact baseline/result SHA, executable command and bound test totals/exit, artifact digests, discriminating failure injection, compatibility impact, separate SD6 review. Run reference-scope for the actual diff and SD2 checkAll before landing. Proposed suite names below are acceptance specifications, not existing or executed tests. No efficacy claim follows from a synthetic pass.

Boundary: The checked record/codec is the records ticket; full HSMM invocation authority stays on the existing invocation ticket.

2026-09-22 operative workflow reconciliation (docs/plans/2026-09-22-recall-encoding-workflow.md):
The public facade is the single execution/configuration boundary used by the study CLI and notebook artifacts. Expose validate, prepare/run, inspect/query, export and compare operations as capabilities become available; spelling is fixed by the implementing CLI documentation, not assumed executable today. Cache prepared sources across recalls; bind resolved evidence/inference/projection profiles and input digests; persist per-attempt failures, resume decisions and partial outcomes. Scientific run completion, artifact validity and requested-capability readiness have distinct exit/readout semantics. Optional temporal/scan capabilities attach through the checked contract and do not gate the base facade. StoryAtlas owns interactive rendering; this ticket publishes the canonical artifacts it consumes.
